name: send-draft-reply
description: Founder approves a drafted reply (optionally edits) and sends to customer. Writes new support_messages row with role='founder'. Transitions ticket to 'sent' or 'resolved'. On resolve: syncs substrate artifact. Pushes to widget via ctx.invokeDO. NO record_learning here — learnings only flow from sweep-pattern-signals when a cross-ticket pattern crosses threshold.
